tasks.title: Setup Next.js Project with TypeScript
tasks.description: Audit and optimize the existing Next.js project structure to prepare for SaaS transformation, ensuring all necessary configurations and integrations are in place.
tasks.details: The project already has Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, component structure, database models, MongoDB connection, scraping infrastructure, and established routing. This task focuses on analyzing the current structure, identifying gaps for SaaS features, optimizing existing code, preparing for Clerk/Stripe integration, setting up environment configurations, and updating dependencies for SaaS functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project structure completeness, run TypeScript compiler to check for errors, ensure all scripts in package.json work correctly, and validate that the project is ready for SaaS feature implementation.

subtasks.title: Analyze current project structure
subtasks.description: Review the existing Next.js project structure and document the current state
subtasks.details: Examine the current folder structure, component organization, database models, and routing setup. Document the existing architecture and identify areas that need optimization for SaaS transformation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create a comprehensive documentation of the current project state with diagrams if necessary.

subtasks.title: Identify gaps for SaaS features
subtasks.description: Determine what components and configurations are missing for full SaaS functionality
subtasks.details: Identify missing elements needed for authentication (Clerk), payment processing (Stripe), caching (Upstash/Redis), error tracking (Sentry), and any other SaaS-specific requirements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create a gap analysis document with prioritized list of missing components.

subtasks.title: Optimize existing code for production
subtasks.description: Review and refactor existing code to ensure it follows best practices for production
subtasks.details: Audit existing components, database models, and scraping functionality. Optimize for performance, maintainability, and scalability. Ensure proper error handling and logging are implemented throughout the codebase.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run performance tests before and after optimization to measure improvements.

subtasks.title: Prepare project for third-party integrations
subtasks.description: Set up the project structure to accommodate Clerk, Stripe, Redis, and Sentry
subtasks.details: Create necessary folders and files for integration with authentication, payment processing, caching, and error tracking services. Prepare configuration files and service wrappers for each integration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project structure can accommodate all required integrations without major refactoring.

subtasks.title: Set up environment configurations
subtasks.description: Configure environment variables and settings for different environments
subtasks.details: Create .env.example file with all required variables. Set up environment-specific configurations for development, testing, and production. Document the required environment variables for each third-party service.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test application startup with different environment configurations to ensure proper loading of variables.

subtasks.title: Update dependencies and package.json
subtasks.description: Add and update dependencies required for SaaS functionality
subtasks.details: Install required dependencies such as @clerk/nextjs, stripe, @upstash/redis, and @sentry/nextjs. Update existing dependencies if needed. Ensure package.json scripts are optimized for development and production workflows.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all dependencies install correctly and don't conflict with existing packages.

subtasks.title: Update Git configuration
subtasks.description: Ensure Git is properly configured for the expanded project scope
subtasks.details: Update .gitignore to exclude environment files and sensitive information. Ensure proper Git hooks are in place for code quality. Document Git workflow for the project.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that sensitive files are properly excluded from Git tracking.

tasks.title: Implement Clerk Authentication
tasks.description: Integrate Clerk for user authentication and management with the existing user system, connecting it to the comprehensive User model already defined in lib/models/user.model.ts.
tasks.details: Install @clerk/nextjs. Set up Clerk provider in _app.tsx. Connect Clerk authentication with existing User model that already has clerkId field, subscription management, usage tracking, GDPR consent, and role-based access control. Implement Clerk webhooks to sync with MongoDB schemas. Add Clerk components to existing pages. Set up middleware to protect routes. Migrate any existing user data to Clerk system.
tasks.testStrategy: Create test accounts, verify email verification process, test password reset functionality, and ensure proper redirection for authenticated and non-authenticated routes. Test integration with existing product tracking functionality and verify data synchronization between Clerk and MongoDB.

subtasks.title: Install Clerk dependencies
subtasks.description: Set up Clerk in the project by installing necessary packages and initializing configuration
subtasks.details: Install @clerk/nextjs package, set up environment variables for Clerk API keys

subtasks.title: Configure Clerk provider
subtasks.description: Set up Clerk provider in the application to enable authentication features
subtasks.details: Wrap the application with ClerkProvider, configure theme and localization options

subtasks.title: Connect Clerk with existing User model
subtasks.description: Integrate Clerk authentication with the existing User model in lib/models/user.model.ts
subtasks.details: Create connection logic between Clerk user accounts and the existing MongoDB User model that already has clerkId field, subscription management, usage tracking, GDPR consent, and role-based access control
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that Clerk user IDs are properly stored in the clerkId field and that user data is correctly synchronized

subtasks.title: Implement Clerk webhooks for MongoDB sync
subtasks.description: Set up webhooks to synchronize Clerk user events with the existing MongoDB schemas
subtasks.details: Create webhook endpoints to handle user creation, updates, and deletion events from Clerk and sync them with the MongoDB User model
subtasks.testStrategy: Test webhook functionality by creating, updating, and deleting users in Clerk and verifying the changes are reflected in MongoDB

subtasks.title: Add Clerk components to existing pages
subtasks.description: Integrate Clerk UI components into the existing application pages
subtasks.details: Add SignIn, SignUp, UserProfile, and other Clerk components to existing pages while maintaining the current application design
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that Clerk components render correctly and function properly within the existing UI

subtasks.title: Set up middleware for route protection
subtasks.description: Implement Clerk middleware to protect routes based on authentication status and user roles
subtasks.details: Configure Clerk middleware to work with Next.js routing and the existing role-based access control system
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that protected routes are only accessible to authenticated users with appropriate roles

subtasks.title: Migrate existing user data to Clerk
subtasks.description: Transfer any existing user accounts to the Clerk authentication system
subtasks.details: Create a migration script to move existing users to Clerk while maintaining their connection to the MongoDB User model
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that migrated users can log in with Clerk and that all their data remains intact

subtasks.title: Test integration with product tracking
subtasks.description: Ensure Clerk authentication works seamlessly with existing product tracking functionality
subtasks.details: Verify that authenticated users' actions are correctly tracked and associated with their user profiles
subtasks.testStrategy: Perform various user actions and verify that they are properly tracked and associated with the correct user

tasks.title: Set Up MongoDB with Optimized Schema
tasks.description: Enhance and optimize the existing MongoDB implementation for production SaaS scale.
tasks.details: Review and optimize the existing MongoDB implementation in the ShopValue project. Focus on production readiness, performance optimization, and SaaS-specific enhancements. The project already has database connection, User, Product, and Analytics models, migration scripts, and a planned indexing strategy.
tasks.testStrategy: Test query performance for common operations. Validate index effectiveness. Implement load testing for production scenarios. Verify data integrity after migrations.

subtasks.title: Review Existing MongoDB Implementation
subtasks.description: Analyze the current MongoDB setup in the ShopValue project
subtasks.details: Review lib/mongoose.ts connection setup, examine existing models (User, Product, Analytics), and understand the current indexing strategy and migration scripts
subtasks.testStrategy: Document findings and identify optimization opportunities

subtasks.title: Optimize Database Connection for Production
subtasks.description: Enhance the existing MongoDB connection for production workloads
subtasks.details: Review and optimize connection pooling settings in lib/mongoose.ts, implement proper error handling and reconnection strategies, and configure timeouts appropriate for production use
subtasks.testStrategy: Test connection resilience under various failure scenarios

subtasks.title: Implement Missing Indexes
subtasks.description: Add any missing indexes defined in the existing models
subtasks.details: Review planned indexing strategy, identify any missing indexes in the current implementation, and implement them with appropriate options for production workloads
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify index creation and test query performance improvements

subtasks.title: Enhance Schemas for SaaS Scale
subtasks.description: Add any missing SaaS-specific fields to existing schemas
subtasks.details: Review User, Product, and Analytics models for SaaS-specific requirements, add missing fields for multi-tenancy, subscription management, or usage tracking if needed
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate schema changes with unit tests

subtasks.title: Optimize Query Performance
subtasks.description: Test and optimize performance of existing database queries
subtasks.details: Identify common or critical queries in the application, test their performance with realistic data volumes, and optimize slow queries using indexes or query restructuring
subtasks.testStrategy: Benchmark query performance before and after optimization

subtasks.title: Implement Database Monitoring
subtasks.description: Set up monitoring and alerting for the MongoDB database
subtasks.details: Implement monitoring for database performance metrics, set up alerting for critical issues, and create dashboards for ongoing database health tracking
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify alerts trigger correctly under simulated failure conditions

subtasks.title: Run and Validate Migration Scripts
subtasks.description: Execute existing migration scripts and ensure data integrity
subtasks.details: Run the existing scripts/db-setup.js migration scripts in a staging environment, validate data integrity after migration, and document any issues or improvements
subtasks.testStrategy: Compare data before and after migration to ensure integrity

tasks.title: Implement Stripe Subscription Management
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe with the existing subscription system, connecting payment processing to the established User model subscription schema.
tasks.details: Connect Stripe to the existing User subscription schema in MongoDB that already has stripeCustomerId and stripeSubscriptionId fields. Implement Stripe webhooks to update existing subscription fields. Create Stripe checkout sessions using the existing tier structure (Free, Pro, Enterprise). Implement usage enforcement based on existing usage schemas. Add subscription management UI to existing user dashboard/pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Test subscription creation, upgrade, downgrade, and cancellation flows with the existing user authentication system. Verify webhook handling for various Stripe events. Ensure proper error handling for failed payments. Test usage enforcement based on subscription tiers.

subtasks.title: Install Stripe SDK
subtasks.description: Set up and configure the Stripe SDK in the ShopValue project
subtasks.details: Install Stripe SDK, set up API keys, and configure environment variables for secure integration with the existing ShopValue project

subtasks.title: Map Existing Subscription Tiers to Stripe
subtasks.description: Create Stripe products and prices that match the existing subscription tier structure
subtasks.details: Map the existing Free, Pro, and Enterprise tiers to corresponding Stripe products and prices, ensuring alignment with the existing User model subscription schema

subtasks.title: Implement Checkout Process
subtasks.description: Create a checkout flow using Stripe Checkout integrated with existing user system
subtasks.details: Implement server-side and client-side code for initiating Stripe Checkout sessions that connect to the existing User model with stripeCustomerId and stripeSubscriptionId fields

subtasks.title: Set Up Webhook Endpoint
subtasks.description: Create an endpoint to handle Stripe webhooks
subtasks.details: Implement a secure endpoint to receive and process Stripe webhook events, including signature verification, that will update the existing User subscription schema

subtasks.title: Handle Subscription Events
subtasks.description: Process subscription-related webhook events to update existing User model
subtasks.details: Implement logic to handle events such as subscription created, updated, and cancelled, ensuring proper updates to the existing User model subscription fields

subtasks.title: Implement Usage Enforcement
subtasks.description: Connect Stripe subscription status to existing usage tracking schema
subtasks.details: Implement logic to enforce usage limits based on the user's subscription tier, using the existing usage tracking schema in the User model

subtasks.title: Integrate Customer Portal with User Dashboard
subtasks.description: Add Stripe Customer Portal to existing user dashboard
subtasks.details: Configure Customer Portal settings in Stripe and implement the necessary server-side logic to create portal sessions, integrating it with the existing user dashboard/pages

subtasks.title: Test End-to-End Integration
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the Stripe integration with existing user system
subtasks.details: Test the entire subscription lifecycle with the existing user authentication system, including sign-ups, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, webhook processing, and usage enforcement

tasks.title: Develop Product Tracking System
tasks.description: Enhance the existing product tracking system to support multi-user functionality, including user-specific tracking, permissions, and analytics.
tasks.details: Extend the existing Product model to support user associations. Implement user-specific product tracking features. Enhance existing components for authenticated users. Add bulk management operations for user product collections. Implement privacy controls and permissions for multi-user access. Optimize product search and filtering for multiple users. Add product analytics and insights features.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user association with products. Verify permissions and privacy controls. Test bulk operations for user-specific product collections. Validate search and filtering with user context. Test analytics features with multiple user scenarios.

subtasks.title: Extend Product model for user associations
subtasks.description: Enhance the existing Product model in lib/models/product.model.ts to support user-specific tracking
subtasks.details: Add user reference fields, tracking status, user-specific notes, and notification preferences to the existing Product model
subtasks.testStrategy: Test model extensions with various user scenarios and verify backward compatibility with existing product data

subtasks.title: Update API endpoints for user-specific product tracking
subtasks.description: Enhance existing API endpoints to support user context for product operations
subtasks.details: Modify API routes to include user authentication, implement user-specific queries, and ensure proper access control
subtasks.testStrategy: Test API endpoints with authenticated and unauthenticated users, verify proper access controls

subtasks.title: Enhance existing UI components for authenticated users
subtasks.description: Update ProductCard and other product components to display user-specific tracking information
subtasks.details: Add tracking indicators, user-specific actions, and personalized information to existing product components
subtasks.testStrategy: Test UI components with different user scenarios and verify proper rendering of user-specific information

subtasks.title: Implement privacy and permission controls
subtasks.description: Create a system to manage product visibility and access permissions between users
subtasks.details: Develop permission models, implement access control in API endpoints, and create UI for managing product sharing
subtasks.testStrategy: Test permission controls with various user scenarios, verify proper enforcement of access restrictions

subtasks.title: Create bulk management operations for user collections
subtasks.description: Implement functionality for users to perform bulk operations on their tracked products
subtasks.details: Enhance existing product management with user context, implement batch operations for user collections, and provide progress tracking
subtasks.testStrategy: Test bulk operations with large user product collections, verify proper handling of permissions and user context

subtasks.title: Optimize product search and filtering for multiple users
subtasks.description: Enhance existing search functionality to support user-specific queries and filters
subtasks.details: Implement user context in search queries, add filters for user-specific product attributes, and optimize performance for multi-user scenarios
subtasks.testStrategy: Test search performance with multiple users and large product collections, verify accuracy of user-specific results

subtasks.title: Implement product analytics and insights
subtasks.description: Add features to provide users with analytics and insights about their tracked products
subtasks.details: Develop price history visualization, comparative analysis between tracked products, and personalized recommendations based on user tracking patterns
subtasks.testStrategy: Test analytics features with various product data scenarios, verify accuracy of insights and performance with large datasets

subtasks.title: Integrate with existing scraping functionality
subtasks.description: Ensure the enhanced product tracking system works seamlessly with existing scraping functionality
subtasks.details: Update the integration between user tracking and the existing scraper in lib/scraper/index.ts, implement user-specific scraping preferences
subtasks.testStrategy: Test scraping functionality with user context, verify proper handling of user-specific scraping preferences

subtasks.title: Perform system integration and testing
subtasks.description: Integrate all enhanced components with the existing product tracking system and conduct thorough testing
subtasks.details: Develop unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for the enhanced multi-user functionality. Conduct performance testing with multiple concurrent users
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the complete system with multiple user scenarios, verify proper integration with existing functionality

tasks.title: Implement Automated Scraping System
tasks.description: Scale and optimize the existing scraping infrastructure to support multi-user SaaS requirements with improved reliability and performance.
tasks.details: Analyze and enhance the existing scraping system in lib/scraper/index.ts. Implement a distributed queue system using Bull and Redis to manage scraping tasks. Add user-based priorities and scheduling based on subscription tiers. Implement robust error handling with exponential backoff for failed attempts. Add anti-detection measures including proxy rotation to avoid IP blocks. Develop monitoring and analytics for scraping operations. Optimize existing cron jobs in app/api/cron/route.ts for multi-user scale.
tasks.testStrategy: Test enhanced scraping system with multiple concurrent users. Verify error handling and retry logic. Test scheduling and priority handling for different user tiers. Monitor scraping success rates and performance metrics. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB integration.

subtasks.title: Analyze existing scraping infrastructure
subtasks.description: Review and document the current scraping system implementation
subtasks.details: Analyze the existing scraper in lib/scraper/index.ts. Document the current architecture, data flow, and integration points. Identify strengths and limitations of the current implementation. Map out integration with MongoDB and existing cron jobs in app/api/cron/route.ts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create comprehensive documentation of the existing system. Identify potential bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

subtasks.title: Set up distributed queue system
subtasks.description: Implement a robust distributed queue system for managing scraping tasks
subtasks.details: Implement Bull with Redis for distributed task queuing. Integrate with the existing scraper in lib/scraper/index.ts. Configure queue producers and consumers. Ensure scalability and fault tolerance while maintaining compatibility with existing functionality.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test queue system with various load patterns. Verify proper task distribution and execution. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB integration.

subtasks.title: Implement user-based scheduling and priorities
subtasks.description: Add support for user-specific scraping schedules and priorities based on subscription tiers
subtasks.details: Design and implement a priority system for scraping tasks based on user subscription levels. Modify existing cron jobs to support user-specific scheduling. Create configuration options for different subscription tiers. Ensure fair resource allocation across users.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test scheduling with simulated users of different tiers. Verify priority handling under load. Ensure backward compatibility with existing scheduling.

subtasks.title: Enhance error handling and recovery
subtasks.description: Improve the error handling capabilities of the existing scraping system
subtasks.details: Implement comprehensive error handling with exponential backoff for the existing scraper. Create a robust logging system for error tracking. Implement automatic recovery mechanisms for failed scraping tasks. Design circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various error conditions to test recovery mechanisms. Verify logging and monitoring of errors. Test backoff strategies under different failure scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement anti-detection measures
subtasks.description: Add capabilities to avoid detection and blocking by target websites
subtasks.details: Implement request fingerprint randomization. Add user-agent rotation. Implement session and cookie management. Design natural browsing patterns to mimic human behavior. Ensure compatibility with the existing scraper implementation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test scraping against sites with known anti-bot measures. Monitor detection rates before and after implementation. Verify impact on scraping success rates.

subtasks.title: Develop proxy rotation mechanism
subtasks.description: Create a system for rotating through multiple proxies to avoid IP bans and improve scraping efficiency
subtasks.details: Implement a proxy pool management system integrated with the existing scraper. Develop logic for selecting and switching proxies. Handle proxy authentication and connection issues. Implement health checks for proxy servers.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test proxy rotation under various conditions. Verify handling of proxy failures. Measure impact on scraping reliability and success rates.

subtasks.title: Integrate with external proxy service
subtasks.description: Establish connection and integration with a third-party proxy service
subtasks.details: Research and select a suitable proxy service provider. Implement API integration for proxy retrieval and management. Ensure secure handling of API keys and authentication. Create fallback mechanisms for service outages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test integration with the selected proxy service. Verify proxy quality and reliability. Test fallback mechanisms during simulated service outages.

subtasks.title: Implement monitoring and analytics
subtasks.description: Develop a comprehensive monitoring and analytics system for scraping operations
subtasks.details: Implement metrics collection for scraping operations. Create dashboards for monitoring scraping performance. Set up alerts for critical issues. Develop analytics for scraping success rates, performance, and resource utilization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify metrics collection under various operating conditions. Test alerting mechanisms. Validate dashboard functionality and data accuracy.

subtasks.title: Optimize cron jobs for multi-user scale
subtasks.description: Enhance existing cron jobs to efficiently handle multiple users and subscription tiers
subtasks.details: Analyze and optimize the existing cron job implementation in app/api/cron/route.ts. Implement load balancing for scraping tasks across users. Add resource limits based on subscription tiers. Ensure fair allocation of scraping resources.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test cron job performance with simulated multi-user load. Measure resource utilization and task completion times. Verify fair allocation across different user tiers.

subtasks.title: Perform system integration and testing
subtasks.description: Integrate all enhanced components and conduct thorough testing of the complete scraping system
subtasks.details: Integrate all enhanced components with the existing scraping system. Develop and execute comprehensive test cases. Perform load testing and optimize system performance. Ensure backward compatibility with existing functionality.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct end-to-end testing of the enhanced scraping system. Perform load testing with simulated multi-user scenarios. Verify all components work together correctly. Ensure no regression in existing functionality.

tasks.title: Set Up Caching with Upstash Redis
tasks.description: Implement caching strategy using Upstash Redis for improved performance.
tasks.details: Install @upstash/redis. Set up Redis connection using environment variables. Implement caching for product search, user subscriptions, price history, popular products, and category data. Create cache invalidation strategies for each data type. Implement automatic cache warming for frequently accessed data.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure API response times with and without caching. Test cache invalidation scenarios. Verify cache hit rates for popular queries.

tasks.title: Develop Notification System with Resend
tasks.description: Create an automated email notification system using Resend for various user communications.
tasks.details: Install resend and react-email. Create React-based email templates for different notification types (price alerts, welcome series, subscription confirmations, etc.). Implement email queue system using Bull and Redis. Set up triggers for different notification types based on user actions and system events. Implement email preference management for users.
tasks.testStrategy: Test email sending for various triggers. Verify email template rendering. Test email queue system for high load scenarios. Check email delivery rates and spam scores.

tasks.title: Implement Admin Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive admin interface for monitoring business metrics and system health.
tasks.details: Design and implement admin dashboard UI. Create API endpoints for fetching aggregated data on user activity, subscriptions, product tracking, and system health. Implement real-time updates using WebSockets or server-sent events. Create visualizations for key metrics using a charting library like Chart.js or D3.js. Implement admin tools for user management and support.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify data accuracy in admin dashboard. Test real-time update functionality. Ensure proper access control for admin routes.

tasks.title: Set Up Analytics and Error Tracking
tasks.description: Integrate Amplitude for analytics and Sentry for error tracking and monitoring.
tasks.details: Install @amplitude/analytics-browser and @sentry/nextjs. Set up Amplitude for tracking user events and business metrics. Configure Sentry for error tracking, performance monitoring, and release tracking. Implement custom error boundaries for React components. Set up automated alerts for critical errors and performance issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify event tracking in Amplitude for key user actions. Test error reporting in Sentry for various error scenarios. Check performance monitoring for slow API calls or component renders.

tasks.title: Implement User Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a user dashboard for managing tracked products and viewing price history.
tasks.details: Design and implement user dashboard UI. Create components for displaying tracked products, price history charts, and alert configurations. Implement pagination or infinite scrolling for product lists. Use a charting library like Chart.js for price history visualization. Implement filtering and sorting options for tracked products.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard rendering with various amounts of tracked products. Verify price history chart accuracy. Test pagination/infinite scrolling performance.

tasks.title: Develop Price Alert System
tasks.description: Create a system for setting and triggering price alerts based on user preferences.
tasks.details: Implement UI for users to set price alert thresholds. Create a background job to check product prices against alert thresholds. Implement logic for triggering alerts based on price drops or availability changes. Integrate with the notification system to send alerts via email or push notifications. Implement alert frequency controls to prevent spam.
tasks.testStrategy: Test alert triggering for various threshold types. Verify alert frequency controls. Test high load scenarios with many simultaneous alerts.

tasks.title: Implement Data Quality Assurance
tasks.description: Develop automated systems for ensuring data quality and accuracy.
tasks.details: Implement price format validation and currency normalization. Create image URL validation with CDN backup storage. Develop product title standardization and cleanup logic. Implement availability status detection with confidence scoring. Create duplicate detection using URL normalization and fuzzy matching algorithms.
tasks.testStrategy: Test data cleaning and normalization with various input formats. Verify duplicate detection accuracy. Test availability status detection with different product page structures.

tasks.title: Set Up Security Measures
tasks.description: Implement security features to protect user data and prevent common vulnerabilities.
tasks.details: Implement input validation using Zod schemas for all API inputs. Set up rate limiting using Upstash Redis. Ensure proper escaping for database queries to prevent injection attacks. Implement XSS protection using React's built-in sanitization. Set up CORS policies. Implement secure session management via Clerk. Use secure environment variable handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform penetration testing for common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, injection attacks). Test rate limiting functionality. Verify secure handling of sensitive data.

tasks.title: Implement GDPR Compliance Features
tasks.description: Develop features to ensure GDPR compliance and user data protection.
tasks.details: Implement a cookie consent banner with preference management. Create an API endpoint for user-initiated data export. Develop an automated account deletion process with complete data purging. Implement audit logging for all data access and modifications. Set up automatic data retention policy enforcement (e.g., 90 days for price history).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify complete data export functionality. Test account deletion process for thoroughness. Check audit logs for completeness. Ensure data retention policies are correctly applied.

tasks.title: Develop API Documentation
tasks.description: Create comprehensive API documentation for internal use and potential future public API.
tasks.details: Use a tool like Swagger or Redoc to generate API documentation. Document all API endpoints, request/response formats, and authentication requirements. Include example requests and responses. Implement API versioning strategy. Create a developer portal for API documentation (for potential future public API).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify accuracy of API documentation against actual implementation. Test example requests in documentation. Ensure all endpoints are properly documented.

tasks.title: Implement Progressive Web App (PWA) Features
tasks.description: Enhance the web application with PWA features for improved user experience.
tasks.details: Implement service worker for offline functionality and caching. Create a web app manifest for installability. Implement push notifications for price alerts (use web-push library). Ensure responsive design for all screen sizes. Implement app shell architecture for faster perceived loading.
tasks.testStrategy: Test PWA installability on various devices. Verify offline functionality. Test push notifications on different browsers and devices. Check performance improvements from app shell architecture.

tasks.title: Set Up Automated Testing Suite
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive automated testing for the application.
tasks.details: Set up Jest for unit and integration testing. Implement React Testing Library for component tests. Set up Playwright for end-to-end testing. Create unit tests for utility functions and hooks. Implement integration tests for API endpoints. Create E2E tests for critical user flows (registration, product tracking, payments). Set up CI/CD pipeline for running tests on each commit.
tasks.testStrategy: Aim for >80% test coverage. Ensure all critical paths are covered by E2E tests. Verify that CI/CD pipeline correctly runs all tests.

tasks.title: Implement Internationalization (i18n)
tasks.description: Add support for multiple languages, starting with Romanian and English.
tasks.details: Use next-i18next for internationalization. Create translation files for Romanian and English. Implement language switching functionality. Ensure all user-facing text is internationalized. Consider right-to-left (RTL) language support for future scalability.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all text is correctly translated in both languages. Test language switching functionality. Ensure no hard-coded strings are left untranslated.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Core Web Vitals
tasks.description: Enhance application performance and improve Core Web Vitals scores.
tasks.details: Implement code splitting and lazy loading for improved initial load time. Optimize images using next/image. Implement resource hints (preload, prefetch) for critical assets. Minimize main-thread work and reduce JavaScript execution time. Optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), First Input Delay (FID), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
tasks.testStrategy: Use Lighthouse and WebPageTest for performance testing. Monitor Core Web Vitals in Google Search Console. Perform real-world performance testing on various devices and network conditions.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Product Categorization
tasks.description: Develop an AI-powered system for automatic product categorization.
tasks.details: Research and select an appropriate machine learning model for product categorization (e.g., BERT, fastText). Implement a training pipeline using historical product data. Create an API endpoint for real-time product categorization. Implement a feedback loop for improving categorization accuracy over time. Consider using a service like Amazon Comprehend for initial implementation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test categorization accuracy on a diverse set of products. Implement A/B testing to compare AI categorization with manual categorization. Monitor and log categorization confidence scores.

tasks.title: Develop Affiliate Integration System
tasks.description: Create a system for integrating affiliate links and tracking affiliate revenue.
tasks.details: Research and integrate with popular affiliate networks (e.g., Amazon Associates, Awin). Implement a system for automatically adding affiliate tags to product links. Create a dashboard for tracking affiliate clicks and revenue. Implement conversion attribution for accurate revenue tracking. Ensure compliance with affiliate program terms and conditions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify correct affiliate tag application across different product URLs. Test affiliate click tracking and attribution. Ensure accurate revenue reporting in the admin dashboard.

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Analytics and Reporting
tasks.description: Develop a comprehensive analytics system for business intelligence and user behavior analysis.
tasks.details: Implement event tracking for all key user actions. Create a data warehouse using BigQuery or Redshift for long-term data storage. Develop ETL processes for aggregating and transforming raw data. Create interactive dashboards using a tool like Metabase or Apache Superset. Implement cohort analysis, retention metrics, and customer lifetime value calculations.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify data accuracy by cross-checking with raw data sources. Test ETL processes for reliability and error handling. Ensure dashboard performance with large datasets.

tasks.title: Set Up Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD)
tasks.description: Implement a robust CI/CD pipeline for automated testing and deployment.
tasks.details: Set up GitHub Actions or a similar CI/CD tool. Implement automated testing on each pull request. Set up staging and production environments. Implement automated deployment to Vercel. Set up database migration scripts and include them in the deployment process. Implement feature flags for safer feature rollouts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the entire CI/CD pipeline with both successful and failing scenarios. Verify that failed tests prevent deployment. Test rollback procedures.

tasks.title: Conduct Security Audit and Penetration Testing
tasks.description: Perform a comprehensive security audit and penetration testing of the application.
tasks.details: Engage a third-party security firm for penetration testing. Conduct a thorough code review focusing on security best practices. Perform automated vulnerability scanning using tools like OWASP ZAP. Conduct manual testing for business logic vulnerabilities. Review and update security policies and procedures.
tasks.testStrategy: Address and verify fixes for all identified vulnerabilities. Conduct a follow-up penetration test to ensure remediation. Implement regular security audits as part of the development process.

tasks.title: User Product Tracking Interface
tasks.description: Create user-friendly interface for tracking products with real-time price alerts and subscription tier limits
tasks.details: Build product tracking UI components with track/untrack functionality. Implement price alert configuration (percentage/absolute thresholds). Integrate with subscription tier limits (Free: 5 products, Pro: 50 products, Premium: unlimited). Add real-time price change notifications. Create price history visualization with interactive charts. Implement bulk tracking operations for managing multiple products.
tasks.testStrategy: Test tracking limits enforcement for each subscription tier. Verify real-time price alert functionality. Test bulk operations with large product sets. Ensure UI responsiveness on mobile devices.

subtasks.title: Core Tracking UI Components
subtasks.description: Develop the fundamental track/untrack button components with proper state management and user feedback
subtasks.details: Create reusable track/untrack button components with loading states, success/error feedback, and proper accessibility. Implement state management for tracking status and handle user interactions with appropriate visual feedback.

subtasks.title: Price Alert Configuration Modal
subtasks.description: Build a modal interface for users to configure price alerts with validation and user-friendly controls
subtasks.details: Design and implement a modal component for setting price thresholds, alert frequencies, and notification preferences. Include form validation, user input sanitization, and clear visual indicators for alert configurations.

subtasks.title: Subscription Service Integration
subtasks.description: Integrate with subscription service to enforce tracking limits based on user tier
subtasks.details: Implement business logic to check user subscription status and enforce tracking limits. Create middleware to validate tracking requests against subscription tiers and provide appropriate user messaging when limits are reached.

subtasks.title: Real-time Price Update Mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement real-time price updates using WebSocket connections or polling mechanisms
subtasks.details: Establish real-time communication for price updates using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events. Implement efficient data synchronization, connection management, and fallback mechanisms for reliable price data delivery.

subtasks.title: Price History Chart Visualization
subtasks.description: Create interactive price history charts with multiple time ranges and data visualization features
subtasks.details: Develop responsive chart components using a charting library to display price history data. Include features like zoom, pan, multiple time ranges, and tooltips. Optimize for performance with large datasets.

subtasks.title: Bulk Track/Untrack Functionality
subtasks.description: Implement bulk operations for tracking/untracking multiple products simultaneously
subtasks.details: Create UI components for bulk selection and operations. Implement batch processing logic with progress indicators, error handling for partial failures, and subscription limit validation for bulk operations.

subtasks.title: Mobile-Responsive Interface Design
subtasks.description: Ensure the entire tracking interface is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices
subtasks.details: Implement responsive design patterns across all components. Optimize touch interactions, adjust layouts for different screen sizes, and ensure proper performance on mobile devices. Test across various devices and browsers.

tasks.title: Advanced Search & Discovery System
tasks.description: Implement intelligent search with filters, auto-complete, and advanced discovery features
tasks.details: Create intelligent search with filters (price range, brand, category, availability). Implement auto-complete and search suggestions with debouncing. Add advanced filtering options (sort by price, popularity, discount). Build recently viewed products feature with local storage. Implement search result relevance scoring. Add search analytics and optimization tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test search performance with large product catalogs. Verify filter combinations work correctly. Test auto-complete responsiveness. Ensure search analytics capture relevant data.

subtasks.title: Search Bar UI with Debounced Auto-complete
subtasks.description: Implement a responsive search bar component with debounced input handling and auto-complete functionality to provide real-time search suggestions while optimizing API calls.
subtasks.details: Create a search input component with debouncing mechanism (300ms delay), implement auto-complete dropdown with keyboard navigation, handle loading states, and ensure mobile responsiveness. Include proper accessibility features and error handling.

subtasks.title: Filter Panel Component
subtasks.description: Develop a comprehensive filter panel component that allows users to refine search results through various criteria with an intuitive interface.
subtasks.details: Build collapsible filter sections, implement multi-select checkboxes, date range pickers, price sliders, and category filters. Include filter state management, clear all functionality, and responsive design for mobile devices.

subtasks.title: Backend API for Search Queries
subtasks.description: Create robust backend API endpoints to handle search queries with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities.
subtasks.details: Implement RESTful API endpoints for search operations, integrate with database indexing, support multiple filter combinations, implement sorting options (relevance, date, price, etc.), add pagination, and optimize query performance with caching strategies.

subtasks.title: Search Relevance Scoring Algorithm
subtasks.description: Implement an intelligent search relevance scoring algorithm to rank search results based on multiple factors and user behavior patterns.
subtasks.details: Develop scoring algorithm considering text matching, popularity metrics, user engagement data, and content freshness. Implement fuzzy matching, synonym handling, and machine learning-based ranking improvements. Include A/B testing framework for algorithm optimization.

subtasks.title: Recently Viewed Feature with Local Storage
subtasks.description: Implement a recently viewed items feature that persists user browsing history using local storage for improved user experience.
subtasks.details: Create local storage management for recently viewed items, implement data persistence with size limits, add recently viewed section to search interface, handle data cleanup and privacy considerations, and ensure cross-tab synchronization.

subtasks.title: Search Analytics Tracking
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive search analytics tracking to monitor user search behavior, popular queries, and system performance metrics.
subtasks.details: Set up event tracking for search queries, filter usage, result clicks, and user engagement metrics. Implement analytics dashboard, create performance monitoring for search response times, track conversion rates, and generate insights for search optimization.

tasks.title: User Dashboard Enhancement
tasks.description: Create comprehensive user dashboard with tracked products, analytics, and management tools
tasks.details: Build personalized dashboard with tracked products grid. Add price history charts and trend analysis. Implement savings calculator and statistics display. Create wishlist and favorites management system. Add quick actions for tracking/untracking products. Implement export functionality for tracked data (CSV/PDF). Add dashboard customization options.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard performance with large numbers of tracked products. Verify chart rendering accuracy. Test export functionality with various data formats. Ensure dashboard is mobile-responsive.

subtasks.title: Main Tracked Products Grid
subtasks.description: Develop the core grid component that displays all tracked products with essential information like product name, current price, price change indicators, and last updated timestamp
subtasks.details: Create a responsive data grid with sorting, filtering, and pagination capabilities. Include product images, price trend indicators, and status badges for tracking status

subtasks.title: Price History Chart Widget
subtasks.description: Build an interactive chart widget that visualizes price trends over time for selected products using line charts or candlestick charts
subtasks.details: Implement chart.js or similar library for rendering price history data. Include zoom functionality, time range selectors, and hover tooltips with detailed price information

subtasks.title: Savings Calculator and Statistics Display
subtasks.description: Create a comprehensive statistics panel showing total savings, average discount percentages, and potential savings calculations
subtasks.details: Develop calculation algorithms for savings metrics, create visual cards/widgets for displaying statistics, and implement real-time updates based on current price data

subtasks.title: Wishlist Management System
subtasks.description: Implement a complete wishlist feature allowing users to add, remove, organize, and manage their desired products for price tracking
subtasks.details: Create wishlist CRUD operations, drag-and-drop organization, category grouping, and integration with the main products grid for seamless tracking activation

subtasks.title: Quick Actions Implementation
subtasks.description: Develop quick action buttons and shortcuts for common dashboard operations like bulk actions, quick filters, and one-click operations
subtasks.details: Implement action buttons for bulk delete, quick price alerts setup, instant wishlist additions, and keyboard shortcuts for power users

subtasks.title: Data Export Functionality
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive data export capabilities supporting both CSV and PDF formats for tracked products, price history, and statistics
subtasks.details: Implement export libraries, create customizable export templates, allow users to select specific data ranges and columns, and generate formatted reports

subtasks.title: Dashboard Layout Customization
subtasks.description: Create a flexible dashboard layout system allowing users to customize widget positions, sizes, and visibility preferences
subtasks.details: Implement drag-and-drop layout builder, widget resize functionality, layout presets, and user preference persistence for personalized dashboard experiences

tasks.title: Mobile Responsiveness & PWA
tasks.description: Ensure optimal mobile experience with Progressive Web App features
tasks.details: Implement mobile-first responsive design across all components. Create touch-friendly interfaces with proper touch targets. Optimize mobile navigation with hamburger menu and bottom navigation. Add Progressive Web App features (service worker, manifest, offline support). Implement basic offline functionality for viewing tracked products. Add push notifications for price alerts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test on various mobile devices and screen sizes. Verify PWA installation and offline functionality. Test push notifications on different browsers. Ensure touch interactions work properly.

subtasks.title: Audit and Implement Mobile-First Responsive CSS
subtasks.description: Conduct comprehensive audit of existing CSS and implement mobile-first responsive design patterns across all components and pages
subtasks.details: Review current CSS architecture, identify non-responsive elements, create mobile-first breakpoint system, update all components with responsive units and flexible layouts, test across multiple device sizes and orientations

subtasks.title: Create Mobile-Specific Navigation Pattern
subtasks.description: Design and implement mobile-optimized navigation system with hamburger menu, touch-friendly interactions, and improved UX for small screens
subtasks.details: Design mobile navigation wireframes, implement collapsible hamburger menu, add touch gestures support, optimize menu animations and transitions, ensure accessibility compliance for mobile navigation

subtasks.title: Implement Service Worker for Caching and Offline Support
subtasks.description: Develop and deploy service worker to enable offline functionality, implement caching strategies for static and dynamic content
subtasks.details: Create service worker file, implement cache-first and network-first strategies, handle offline scenarios, manage cache versioning and updates, add background sync capabilities for form submissions

subtasks.title: Create Web App Manifest File
subtasks.description: Generate comprehensive web app manifest with proper metadata, icons, and configuration for PWA installation and app-like experience
subtasks.details: Define app metadata (name, description, theme colors), create icon sets for various sizes and platforms, configure display modes and orientation preferences, set up start URL and scope, test installation prompts across browsers

subtasks.title: Set Up Push Notifications Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Implement push notification system including server-side setup, client-side subscription management, and notification handling
subtasks.details: Configure push notification service (Firebase/OneSignal), implement subscription management in service worker, create notification permission requests, develop server-side push API integration, test notification delivery and click handling

tasks.title: Real-Time Price Alert System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive price alerting system with multiple notification channels
tasks.details: Create price alert configuration UI with percentage and absolute thresholds. Implement multiple notification channels (email, push, in-app). Add alert frequency management (instant, daily, weekly). Create alert history and management dashboard. Implement smart alerts based on price trends and patterns. Add alert scheduling and snooze functionality.
tasks.testStrategy: Test alert triggering accuracy with various price scenarios. Verify notification delivery across all channels. Test alert management and history features. Ensure alerts respect user preferences.

subtasks.title: Alert Configuration UI
subtasks.description: Design and implement the user interface for creating, editing, and managing price alerts with various trigger conditions and notification preferences
subtasks.details: Create forms for setting price thresholds, percentage changes, time-based conditions, and notification method selection. Include validation, preview functionality, and intuitive UX for complex alert rules.

subtasks.title: Backend Logic for Price Trigger Evaluation
subtasks.description: Develop the core backend system that monitors price changes and evaluates user-defined alert conditions in real-time
subtasks.details: Implement scalable price monitoring service, rule engine for complex conditions, database optimization for high-frequency updates, and efficient alert triggering mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Email Notification Integration
subtasks.description: Integrate email service provider and implement email notification functionality for price alerts
subtasks.details: Set up SMTP/API integration with email service, create responsive email templates, implement delivery tracking, handle bounces and failures, and ensure compliance with email regulations.

subtasks.title: Push Notification Integration
subtasks.description: Implement push notification system for mobile and web applications to deliver real-time price alerts
subtasks.details: Integrate with push notification services (FCM, APNs), handle device registration, implement notification queuing and retry logic, and ensure cross-platform compatibility.

subtasks.title: In-App Notification Component
subtasks.description: Create in-application notification system to display price alerts within the user interface
subtasks.details: Build notification center UI, implement real-time updates via WebSocket/SSE, create notification badges and counters, and provide mark-as-read functionality.

subtasks.title: Alert History and Management Dashboard
subtasks.description: Develop comprehensive dashboard for users to view alert history, manage active alerts, and analyze notification performance
subtasks.details: Create data visualization for alert statistics, implement filtering and search functionality, provide bulk management operations, and include performance metrics and delivery status tracking.

tasks.title: Social Features & Sharing
tasks.description: Add social sharing capabilities and community features
tasks.details: Implement product sharing with social media integration. Create shareable tracking lists (public/private). Add community deal sharing features. Implement social media integration for sharing deals. Create product review and rating system. Add friend system for sharing deals privately.
tasks.testStrategy: Test social media sharing across platforms. Verify privacy settings for shared lists. Test community features for appropriate content. Ensure social features don't compromise user privacy.

subtasks.title: Implement Standard Social Media Share Buttons
subtasks.description: Create social media sharing functionality with buttons for major platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc.) allowing users to share products and deals
subtasks.details: Develop reusable share button components with platform-specific APIs, implement Open Graph meta tags for rich sharing previews, and add analytics tracking for share events

subtasks.title: Develop Shareable Product Lists with Privacy Settings
subtasks.description: Build a system for users to create, manage, and share product lists with configurable public/private visibility settings
subtasks.details: Design database schema for product lists, implement CRUD operations, create privacy controls UI, develop sharing mechanisms with unique URLs, and add list collaboration features

subtasks.title: Build Product Review and Rating System
subtasks.description: Create a comprehensive review system allowing users to rate products, write reviews, and view aggregated ratings
subtasks.details: Design review database schema, implement star rating UI components, create review submission and moderation workflows, develop rating aggregation algorithms, and add review helpfulness voting

subtasks.title: Create Community Deal Submission Feature
subtasks.description: Develop functionality for users to submit and share deals they discover, with community validation and moderation
subtasks.details: Build deal submission forms, implement deal validation and verification processes, create community voting mechanisms, develop moderation tools, and integrate with existing review system for deal quality assessment

subtasks.title: Implement Basic Friend System
subtasks.description: Create a friend/follower system allowing users to connect, follow each other's activities, and share lists privately
subtasks.details: Design user relationship database schema, implement friend request/acceptance workflows, create friend discovery features, develop activity feeds, and integrate with shareable lists for friend-only sharing options

tasks.title: AI-Powered Recommendations
tasks.description: Implement intelligent product recommendations and price predictions
tasks.details: Develop personalized product recommendation engine based on user behavior. Implement price prediction algorithms using historical data. Create 'best time to buy' recommendations. Add similar product suggestions. Implement trend analysis and market insights. Create AI-powered deal alerts for products user might be interested in.
tasks.testStrategy: Test recommendation accuracy with diverse user profiles. Verify price prediction algorithms against historical data. Test recommendation performance with large product catalogs. Ensure AI features provide genuine value.

subtasks.title: Develop Data Pipeline for User Behavior
subtasks.description: Create a comprehensive data pipeline to collect, process, and store user behavior data including browsing patterns, purchase history, search queries, and interaction metrics for recommendation system training
subtasks.details: Design and implement ETL processes for user tracking data, establish data schemas for behavior analytics, create data validation and cleaning procedures, and set up real-time data streaming capabilities

subtasks.title: Build and Train Personalized Product Recommendation Model
subtasks.description: Develop and train machine learning models for personalized product recommendations using collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and hybrid approaches
subtasks.details: Research and implement recommendation algorithms (matrix factorization, deep learning models), create training pipelines, perform hyperparameter tuning, and validate model performance using A/B testing frameworks

subtasks.title: Create Price Prediction Model Using Historical Data
subtasks.description: Build a machine learning model to predict optimal pricing strategies and price trends using historical sales data, market conditions, and competitor analysis
subtasks.details: Collect and preprocess historical pricing data, implement time series forecasting models, incorporate external market factors, and create price optimization algorithms with demand elasticity considerations

subtasks.title: Develop API to Serve Recommendation Results
subtasks.description: Create a scalable REST API service to serve personalized recommendations and price predictions with low latency and high availability
subtasks.details: Design API endpoints for recommendations and pricing, implement caching strategies, create model serving infrastructure, establish monitoring and logging, and ensure API security and rate limiting

subtasks.title: Integrate AI Recommendations into UI
subtasks.description: Integrate the AI-powered recommendation system into the user interface with personalized product suggestions, dynamic pricing displays, and recommendation widgets
subtasks.details: Create UI components for displaying recommendations, implement real-time recommendation updates, design A/B testing interfaces for recommendation variants, and add analytics tracking for recommendation performance

tasks.title: Multi-Currency Support
tasks.description: Add support for multiple currencies and international markets
tasks.details: Implement multi-currency price display with real-time exchange rates. Create currency conversion utilities and historical rate tracking. Add regional price variations and market-specific pricing. Consider international shipping costs in price comparisons. Implement localized content and currency preferences. Add currency-specific price alerts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test currency conversion accuracy. Verify regional price variations. Test currency preference persistence. Ensure proper handling of exchange rate fluctuations.

subtasks.title: Integrate Real-Time Currency Exchange Rate Service
subtasks.description: Research, select, and integrate a reliable third-party currency exchange rate API service to provide real-time exchange rates for multiple currencies
subtasks.details: Evaluate different currency exchange rate providers (e.g., Fixer.io, CurrencyLayer, ExchangeRate-API), implement API integration with proper error handling, caching mechanisms, and fallback strategies for service unavailability

subtasks.title: Create Global Price Display Component
subtasks.description: Develop a reusable UI component that can display prices in different currencies with automatic conversion based on current exchange rates
subtasks.details: Build a flexible price display component that accepts base currency and amount, performs real-time conversion, handles formatting for different currency symbols and decimal places, and provides consistent styling across the application

subtasks.title: Update Backend Calculations for Currency Awareness
subtasks.description: Modify all backend services, APIs, and database operations to handle multi-currency calculations and storage
subtasks.details: Update database schema to store currency information alongside prices, modify calculation logic for taxes, discounts, and totals to be currency-aware, implement currency conversion in backend services, and ensure data consistency across all financial operations

subtasks.title: Implement User Currency Preferences
subtasks.description: Create user preference system allowing users to select and save their preferred currency for displaying prices throughout the application
subtasks.details: Add currency preference settings to user profiles, implement currency selection UI components, create middleware to apply user currency preferences across all price displays, and handle guest user currency detection based on location or browser settings

subtasks.title: Adapt Price Alert System for Multiple Currencies
subtasks.description: Modify the existing price alert system to handle alerts in different currencies and convert thresholds appropriately
subtasks.details: Update alert creation to specify currency, modify alert evaluation logic to handle currency conversions when comparing prices, ensure alert notifications display prices in user's preferred currency, and handle edge cases where exchange rate fluctuations might trigger false alerts

tasks.title: Advanced Analytics Dashboard
tasks.description: Create comprehensive analytics for users and admins
tasks.details: Develop user behavior analytics dashboard. Implement product performance metrics and market trend analysis. Create cohort analysis for user subscriptions. Add revenue and growth analytics. Implement A/B testing framework for feature optimization. Create custom analytics reports and data export.
tasks.testStrategy: Test analytics accuracy against raw data. Verify dashboard performance with large datasets. Test custom report generation. Ensure user privacy in analytics collection.

subtasks.title: Set up data pipeline for analytics events
subtasks.description: Design and implement a robust data pipeline to collect, process, and store analytics events from various sources. This includes setting up event tracking, data ingestion, ETL processes, and data warehousing infrastructure.
subtasks.details: Configure event collection APIs, implement data validation and cleaning processes, set up real-time and batch processing pipelines, establish data storage schemas, and ensure scalability for high-volume data ingestion.

subtasks.title: Build admin dashboard UI
subtasks.description: Create the user interface for the analytics dashboard with intuitive navigation, responsive design, and interactive data visualization components. Focus on user experience and accessibility.
subtasks.details: Design dashboard layout, implement responsive UI components, create interactive charts and graphs, build navigation system, add filtering and search capabilities, and ensure cross-browser compatibility.

subtasks.title: Develop cohort analysis module
subtasks.description: Build a comprehensive cohort analysis system to track user behavior patterns over time, including user retention, engagement metrics, and lifecycle analysis with customizable time periods and segmentation.
subtasks.details: Implement cohort calculation algorithms, create cohort visualization components, build user segmentation logic, add retention rate calculations, and develop time-based analysis features.

subtasks.title: Develop revenue tracking module
subtasks.description: Create a revenue analytics system to monitor financial metrics, track conversion funnels, analyze revenue trends, and provide insights into monetization performance across different user segments.
subtasks.details: Implement revenue calculation engines, build financial reporting components, create conversion funnel analysis, add revenue forecasting capabilities, and integrate payment data sources.

subtasks.title: Implement A/B testing framework
subtasks.description: Develop a flexible A/B testing platform that allows for experiment design, user segmentation, statistical analysis, and result interpretation with support for multiple concurrent tests.
subtasks.details: Build experiment configuration system, implement user assignment algorithms, create statistical significance calculations, develop result visualization tools, and add experiment management interfaces.

subtasks.title: Create custom report generation feature and ensure data privacy compliance
subtasks.description: Build a flexible report generation system allowing users to create custom analytics reports while implementing comprehensive data privacy measures including GDPR compliance, data anonymization, and access controls.
subtasks.details: Develop report builder interface, implement data export functionality, create scheduling system for automated reports, add data anonymization features, implement access control mechanisms, and ensure GDPR/privacy regulation compliance.

tasks.title: API Development & Documentation
tasks.description: Create public API with comprehensive documentation
tasks.details: Develop RESTful API for price data and product information. Implement API authentication and rate limiting. Create webhook system for real-time price updates. Build comprehensive API documentation with examples. Add developer portal with API keys management. Implement API versioning and backward compatibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API performance and reliability. Verify authentication and rate limiting. Test webhook delivery and reliability. Ensure API documentation accuracy.

subtasks.title: Design OpenAPI Specification
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 specification defining all API endpoints, request/response schemas, authentication methods, and error handling patterns
subtasks.details: Define REST API structure, data models, endpoint paths, HTTP methods, status codes, and validation rules. Include examples and detailed descriptions for all operations.

subtasks.title: Implement API Authentication & Rate Limiting
subtasks.description: Develop OAuth2 authentication system with JWT tokens and implement rate limiting middleware to protect API resources
subtasks.details: Set up OAuth2 authorization server, implement token validation, create rate limiting based on API keys/user tiers, and add security headers and CORS configuration.

subtasks.title: Develop Core RESTful Endpoints
subtasks.description: Build all primary API endpoints following REST principles with proper error handling, validation, and response formatting
subtasks.details: Implement CRUD operations, search/filtering capabilities, pagination, sorting, and ensure consistent response formats across all endpoints with proper HTTP status codes.

subtasks.title: Build Webhook Delivery System
subtasks.description: Create reliable webhook infrastructure for real-time event notifications with retry mechanisms and delivery tracking
subtasks.details: Implement webhook registration endpoints, event queue system, retry logic with exponential backoff, delivery status tracking, and webhook signature verification.

subtasks.title: Generate Interactive API Documentation
subtasks.description: Create auto-generated interactive documentation from OpenAPI spec with testing capabilities and code examples
subtasks.details: Set up Swagger UI or similar tool, generate code samples in multiple languages, create interactive testing interface, and ensure documentation stays synchronized with API changes.

subtasks.title: Create Developer Portal for API Key Management
subtasks.description: Build web portal for developers to register, manage API keys, view usage analytics, and access documentation
subtasks.details: Develop user registration/login system, API key generation and management interface, usage dashboards with analytics, billing integration, and support ticket system.

metadata.description: Phase 1 critical features from the PRD - User Experience Enhancement
